text:
marta: Quick design question — compact modal on the Console: when the title is long the close (X) overlaps with the trailing toast stack on smaller viewports. copy is also inconsistent: some screens say "Close", others use an icon-only button. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/console/modal-overlap-1.png

kevin: ugh yeah saw that during QA. repro steps? which breakpoint?

marta: Chrome, 1366x768, flow: open dataset modal -> paste very long name (100+ chars) -> notice X gets visually cramped and toast covers part of the icon. happens with both primary and ghost variants.

anna: accessibility nit: icon-only close needs an aria-label and a visible focus ring. some of the modal variants are missing `aria-label` on the close button. suggested `aria-label="Close dialog"`.

kevin: good call. also the hit target for the X looks <44px on mobile. we should use the spacing token `spacing.sz-10` as min tap target.

sam: Agree on tap target. For copy: I'd like consistency — either icon+label for big modals and icon-only for compact, but we should always provide accessible text. Proposal: compact = icon-only + aria-label, regular = "Close" visible label. Thoughts?

jeff: +1 on that pattern. Also maybe stack toasts slightly offset from modal edge when present so they don't overlap interactive controls. simple CSS transform on toast container when modal open?

marta: sounds good. One more thing: current close color for ghost button is #6b7280 which has low contrast on our dark header. We should bump to token `color.text-strong` or `neutral-700`.

anna: I'll run contrast check. If we need to change color we should add it as a token update. accessibility regression tests should catch it.

design-bot: Reminder: design token PRs must include the token migration plan and a screenshots doc. See https://redwood.dev/token-guidelines

kevin: For implementation: small patch — add `aria-label` attr, ensure focus ring via `.focus-visible`, increase hit area with padding, and update toast z-index on modal open. I can do a CSS-first approach, but might need a small runtime flag for dynamic toast offset.

sam: If you do the CSS approach, add a comment in the modal stylesheet explaining the breakpoint math. keep it under 50 lines.

marta: For copy tweak: replace inconsistent "Close" vs "Dismiss" — we should standardize on "Close" for modal controls and "Dismiss" for toasts. @kevin can you sweep the repo?

kevin: yep will grep and open PR. plan: 1) aria-labels + focus ring 2) bump close color token 3) toast offset toggle 4) copy sweep. I'll open PR #4567 today.

anna: I'll review the PR for a11y. please include unit tests for aria presence and a screenshot test for the long title case.

marta: thanks all. can we include a short note in the changelog about the copy change so UX writers can sync? @jeff can you ping them after merge?

jeff: will do. :thumbsup:

sam: Nice & short. assigning follow-up -> PR #4567, reviewers: anna, marta. closing this thread after PR linked.

marta: awesome — thanks!
